title: Open The Lock

contractDetails.constraints: 1–500 forbidden strings. Each forbidden string and target has four decimal digits, including leading zeros. target is not forbidden.
contractDetails.output-checking: Keep four-digit strings including leading zeros. Compare shortest turn count or −1.

statement: A four-wheel lock starts at 0000. One move changes one wheel by one digit, wrapping between 0 and 9. Forbidden combinations cannot be occupied. Return the fewest moves to reach target, or −1 if unreachable.

examples.explanation: Change the last two wheels once each.
The lock cannot start in a forbidden combination.

constraints: 1–500 forbidden strings. Each forbidden string and target has four decimal digits, including leading zeros. target is not forbidden.
hints: Conceptual: Every lock state has up to eight legal one-move neighbors.
Directional: Explore in layers of equal move count.
Implementation: Use BFS from 0000, excluding forbidden and already visited states. Treat a forbidden starting state as unreachable.
complexityAnalysis: O(10000) time and auxiliary space for the fixed state graph.
